home.titleCalm: Nothing due back in a hurry today
home.bodyNext: Next due is {{name}} ({{serial}}) on {{date}} - you can extend it from the list below.
home.bodyOverdue: {{name}} ({{serial}}) is {{count}} day(s) overdue. Please bring it back to the counter.
home.bodyNone: Start by picking what you need from the catalogue, then send a request.
home.extendNote: Whether an extension is granted at once or needs staff or a supervisor, and how far the due date moves, depends on the item, your credit band and the next booking. Both are shown before you confirm.

appeals.subtitle: Appeal a credit deduction
appeals.intro: If you think a damage assessment is wrong, you can appeal it within 7 days of the deduction. A supervisor decides, never the person who inspected the item, and can cancel the penalty, reduce it, or let it stand. Late-return and loss penalties are counted by the clock and cannot be appealed.
appeals.pickHelp: Only deductions still inside their 7-day window are listed. A late return and damage on the same loan are separate deductions, appealed separately.
appeals.noneBody: Credit deductions you can still appeal appear here.
appeals.whyPlaceholder: Explain how the real condition differs from the verdict - e.g. this scratch was there before I collected it…
appeals.needPick: Choose a deduction to appeal first.
appeals.needWhy: Write the reason you are contesting it.
appeals.sentNote: Sent to a supervisor. You will be notified of the decision · an appeal cannot be withdrawn.
appeals.evidenceTitle: Photos on file for this loan
appeals.evidenceHelp: The supervisor sees the same photos. These are fixed - to add your own, use Your evidence below.
appeals.evidenceNone: No photos on file for this loan.
appeals.myEvidenceHelp: Attach photos that support your case. The supervisor sees them together with the before/after photos and the staff report.

catalog.subtitle: Browse equipment available across the faculty, check live stock, and add what you need to a borrow request
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code or brand

catalog.addCapped: Every free unit is already in your request
catalog.emptyDesc: Try removing a filter or searching for something else
catalog.notEligibleHint: Your department or role isn't on this item's borrowing list. Staff decide who may borrow it.

detail.notFoundDesc: This item may have been removed from the system. Try finding it again from the catalog.

rooms.subtitle: Browse labs, meeting rooms, and shared spaces across the faculty. Check today's free slots and book one.
rooms.note: Room booking is separate from equipment borrowing. If you also need equipment in the room, create a separate equipment request.
rooms.emptyDesc: Try removing a filter or changing your search term.
rooms.heldNote: You already hold a booking for {{name}}. Cancel it or finish using it to book another room.

request.subtitle: Review what you picked, set the period you need it for, then submit.
request.emptyBody: Add equipment from the catalog to start a borrowing request.
request.periodHelp: Credit level {{band}} allows up to {{days}} days per loan · book at most {{horizon}} days ahead
request.calWarn: Credit level {{band}} allows up to {{days}} days per loan · the return date was not set, pick one inside the allowed range
request.serialHelp: T2 equipment is issued by serial and needs supervisor approval.
request.sumPerUnit: Each unit gets its own request number and moves on its own - approved, collected, and returned separately.
request.pcEligibleOk: Everything in this request is approved automatically.
request.pcEligibleSup: You may borrow, but this request needs your supervisor's approval first.
request.pcCreditOk: {{score}} points (level {{band}}) · {{days}} day(s) requested of a {{max}}-day cap
request.pcCreditOver: {{days}} day(s) requested exceeds the {{max}}-day cap for this credit level · pick an earlier return date
request.pcTimePast: The selected pickup time has passed. Choose another time or date.
request.pcTimeOrder: The return time must be after the pickup time.
request.pcStockOk: Every line has enough units free.
request.pcStockBad: {{items}} does not have enough units free · reduce the quantity or remove it
request.pcTooMany: A request can contain at most {{max}} units. Reduce the quantity.
request.pcNothing: Nothing in the request yet - add equipment before submitting.
request.apvAuto: This request contains only T0–T1 items. Entitlements are checked and it is approved automatically on submission.
request.apvT2: This request contains T2 equipment. Only the T2 lines wait for supervisor approval - T0–T1 lines in the same request are approved automatically and can be collected right away.
request.apvLowCredit: Your credit level is {{band}}. Under the rules, both T1 and T2 items need supervisor approval regardless of the item.
request.submitPartial: {{created}} unit(s) submitted and {{rejected}} failed. Failed units remain in the draft:
request.submitUnitsChanged: Availability for {{item}} changed. Review the request and try again.
request.submitInvalidItem: The equipment data for {{item}} is invalid. Remove it and select it again.
request.autoApproveNote: T0–T1 items are approved automatically on submission and can be collected the same day.
request.shortenConfirm: This unit already has a booking starting {{date}}. Shorten this loan to end then instead?

pickup.subtitle: Collect the equipment staff have prepared for you
pickup.pickHelp: Collect several at once - staff issue a single handover slip · anything left unticked stays in the pickup queue.
pickup.verifyHelp: Check the serial on the equipment against the one shown here before confirming.
pickup.swapNote: The photo is your record that you took this unit. To give it up now you must collect it, return it, and send a new request.
pickup.photoHelp: This is your own evidence - used at return time if the inspection disagrees with the real condition.
pickup.photoPer: One photo per unit; photograph every item you are collecting.
pickup.after: Once confirmed the status becomes “On loan” and the return countdown starts immediately.
pickup.blockShots: {{count}} photo(s) still missing - photograph every selected item before confirming.
pickup.blockUsage: Preparation data is not available yet. Refresh or ask staff for help.
pickup.noneBody: Once a request is approved and staff have prepared it, it appears here.
pickup.photoTooLarge: File is larger than {{max}} MB - retake it or shrink it first.
pickup.photoBadType: Only JPG or PNG images are accepted.
pickup.swapAtCounter: Want a different unit? Ask staff at the counter before you photograph this one - they make the swap.

booking.subtitle: Pick the time slots you need today, say what the room is for, then submit.
booking.notFoundDesc: This room may have been removed. Try picking another from the room list.
booking.dateHelp: Fixed facilities (T3) are booked same-day only. Each slot is {{minutes}} minutes, with a maximum of {{hours}} hours per booking.
booking.sameDay: Fixed facilities are same-day only; the date cannot be changed.
booking.slotHelp: Pick up to {{max}} slots ({{hours}} hours). Booked slots cannot be selected.
booking.slotBreak: 12:00–13:00 is the lunch break - not bookable, and a booking cannot span it.
booking.pickSlotWarn: Select at least one time slot before submitting the booking request.
booking.roomFullWarn: Every slot for this room is taken today. Try another room, or come back tomorrow.
booking.approvalNote: The booking is confirmed as soon as you send it - nobody else can take those hours. Staff open the room for you before you go in.
booking.autoNote: Confirmed on submission · photograph the room before and after use · one booking at a time.
booking.heldWarn: You already hold a booking for {{name}}. One room at a time - cancel it or finish using it first.
booking.closedWarn: This room is closed for booking right now.

roomUse.subtitle: Check in and use the rooms you booked
roomUse.intro: Fixed facilities (T3) must be photographed before and after every use. Staff use the pair when they run the daily condition check.
roomUse.needBefore: Photograph the room before you can check in.
roomUse.waitStaff: Your booking is confirmed. Staff open the room before you can photograph it and go in.
roomUse.needAfter: Photograph the room after use before you hand it back.
roomUse.cancelConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to cancel this room booking? This action cannot be undone.
roomUse.doneNote: Before and after photos sent to staff for the condition check
roomUse.noneBody: Once a booking is confirmed the room appears here, ready to check in.
roomUse.photoTooLarge: File is larger than {{max}} MB - retake it or shrink it first.
roomUse.photoBadType: Only JPG or PNG images are accepted.
roomUse.handBack: When you are done, photograph the room as you leave it and hand it back to staff. Staff close the booking after comparing the two photos.
roomUse.staffChecking: Handed back. Staff are checking the room against your photos and will close the booking.

myRequests.noteCancelled: Cancelled - the slot has been released to other borrowers.

myRequests.extAskStaff: Staff must check the item at the counter before granting this extension. Confirm when you are ready to bring it in.
myRequests.extAskSup: This extension is a supervisor’s decision, not yours to grant. Confirm to send the request.
myRequests.cancelConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to cancel this request? This action cannot be undone.
myRequests.draftNote: This draft has not been submitted. Open it, finish it, and send whenever you like.
myRequests.extBlockedOverdue: This loan is too far overdue to extend - return the item, or send a new request
myRequests.extBlockedWindow: Someone else is booked on this item - it cannot be held any longer
myRequests.extBlockedQuota: No extensions left on this loan
myRequests.extBlockedNotCollected: Collect this item before asking for more time
myRequests.extAuto: Granted straight away · {{count}} extension(s) left on this loan
myRequests.extAskAuto: This extension is granted straight away - nobody else has to approve it.
myRequests.extPendingStaff: Extension to {{date}} requested - bring the item to the counter for staff to check
myRequests.extPendingSup: Extension to {{date}} requested - waiting for the supervisor's decision
